description: This file defines the CyclicBuffer class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It provides an interface for a process-wide, shared cyclic buffer with locking mechanisms, data reading/writing, and buffer management functionalities. The class is designed for inter-process communication and includes methods for locking, unlocking, peeking, reading, writing, reserving space, and validation. It also defines an internal Cursor class for buffer position management.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class that manages a shared, process-wide cyclic buffer with locking, reading, writing, and buffer management capabilities for inter-process data sharing.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer::Cursor
classes.description: An internal helper class for managing read position within the cyclic buffer, supporting peeking and tail calculations.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the cyclic buffer with file parameters or existing buffer.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Virtual method called when data becomes available in the buffer.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the buffer for exclusive access, optionally waiting for data presence.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Reads data non-destructively from the buffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads and consumes data from the buffer.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for future writes.
